_example_notes: Use the exact frozen cohort dataset_id, domain, and source_group; the prepare CLI validates them against the cohort manifest.
Set each numeric dtype to its original fixed width: int8/uint8/int16/uint16/int32/uint32/int64/uint64/float16/float32/float64.
For exact NaN payloads use bits16:/bits32:/bits64: tokens; plain NaN remains a present value, never a null.
Datetime input supports microsecond precision; use integer epoch input with source_unit=ns for nanosecond timestamps.
The source must already be a locally audited CSV export. This script does not download or infer Hugging Face schemas.
